description: This Java source file contains an integration test class 'LoanChargeOffAccrualTest' that extends 'BaseLoanIntegrationTest'. It tests the loan charge-off accrual process within the Apache Fineract project. The test setup involves creating a client and loan, disbursing funds, executing charge-offs, and verifying loan transactions and accruals over simulated dates.

classes.name: LoanChargeOffAccrualTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 integration test class that verifies the correct behavior of loan charge-off accrual and related transaction processing.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Set up test preconditions by creating a client, a loan product, a loan, and disbursing funds before each test.

methods.name: loanChargeOffAccrualTest
methods.description: Main test method that simulates the passage of days, executes charge-offs, and verifies the accrual transactions are correctly recorded.
